subject: Quick follow-up from TradeCraft — next steps & discovery
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@tradecraft.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up from TradeCraft — next steps & discovery

Hi Lina — great meeting you at the TradeCraft Summit on Friday. Thanks again for spending a few minutes at our booth — I appreciated hearing about the image-search feature you’re building and the latency/cost constraints you mentioned.

Per our quick chat, attached is a short deck that covers:
- Redwood inference modes (hosted vs dedicated vs private)
- Typical latency/cost tradeoffs for embedding + re-ranking workloads
- A proposed 30/60/90 mutual action plan and a discovery checklist

If it’s useful, I can lock in a 30-minute discovery next week to walk through: sample traffic patterns, SLOs (p50/p95 target), and what success would look like for TradeCraft. Proposed times: Tue 11/3 10:00–10:30am PT or Wed 11/4 2:00–2:30pm PT. Tell me what works and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Account Exec, Mid Market
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments:
- redwood-tradecraft-deck.pdf (pdf)
- tradecraft-discovery-template.xlsx (xlsx)

-----------------------------
On Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:52:00 -0700 Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@tradecraft.ai> wrote:
> Hi Jordan — thanks for the deck. I skimmed it and it looks aligned with what we discussed.
> 
> Quick heads up: our infra lead is out this week and procurement just kicked off an architecture review, so I don’t have full availability for a deep discovery until mid-November. Can we hold off on booking until I confirm with my team?
> 
> Appreciate the follow-up — Lina
> 
> --
> Lina Gomez
> Head of AI Product
> TradeCraft Labs

-----------------------------
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@tradecraft.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from TradeCraft — next steps & discovery

Hi Lina — circling back as you mentioned mid-November could be better. Wanted to check two quick things so we can prioritize correctly on our side: 

1) Priority change: Has the priority for the image-search/embedding work shifted vs what you described at the booth (p95 latency target ~150ms, batched offline re-ranking)?
2) Timing: Do you expect a window for discovery the week of Nov 16 or sometime after the architecture review wraps up?

If helpful, I can send a 20-minute intake form (few questions + traffic sample request) that your infra person can fill asynchronously — then the discovery call can focus on trade-offs and a quick demo.

No rush — just want to make sure I don’t keep pinging while you’re heads down.

Best,
Jordan

-----------------------------
From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@tradecraft.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from TradeCraft — next steps & discovery

Hi Jordan — apologies for the radio silence, thanks for the nudge. We wrapped the architecture review this morning.

Priority is still there but we need to align with security/compliance for data residency before any on-prem or private deployment conversations. That said, I think a short discovery call would be useful — Nov 17 at 11am PT works for me and I’ll invite our infra lead (Alex) to join.

Please send the intake form and a calendar invite, and I’ll have the team bring traffic samples and the list of compliance questions we had.

Looking forward to it — Lina

--

Head of AI Product, TradeCraft Labs
